go-jsonschema generate --schema https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema --out ./model --package model --type Schema

exec go vet ./model
exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- go.mod --
module example.com/metafull

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

// The full 2020-12 meta-schema collapses every vocabulary's
// keywords into a single SchemaObject via the Phase 10
// allOf-merge + Phase 14 cross-document $ref resolution.
func TestSchema_MergedVocabularies(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(SchemaObject{})
	expectedFields := []string{
		// Core
		"Id", "Schema", "Ref", "Anchor", "DynamicRef", "DynamicAnchor", "Defs", "Vocabulary", "Comment",
		// Applicator
		"AllOf", "AnyOf", "OneOf", "Not", "If", "Then", "Else",
		"Properties", "PatternProperties", "AdditionalProperties",
		"Items", "PrefixItems", "Contains",
		"DependentSchemas",
		// Validation
		"Type", "Enum", "Const",
		"MultipleOf", "Maximum", "Minimum",
		"MaxLength", "MinLength", "Pattern",
		"MaxItems", "MinItems", "UniqueItems",
		"Required", "DependentRequired",
		// Meta-data
		"Title", "Description", "Default", "Deprecated", "ReadOnly", "WriteOnly", "Examples",
		// Format
		"Format",
		// Content
		"ContentEncoding", "ContentMediaType", "ContentSchema",
	}
	got := make(map[string]bool, rt.NumField())
	for i := 0; i < rt.NumField(); i++ {
		got[rt.Field(i).Name] = true
	}
	for _, f := range expectedFields {
		if !got[f] {
			t.Errorf("SchemaObject missing field %q", f)
		}
	}
}

func TestSchema_BooleanVariant(t *testing.T) {
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`true`), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal(true): %v", err)
	}
	if got, ok := s.TypeBoolean(); !ok || got != true {
		t.Errorf("TypeBoolean = (%v, %v), want (true, true)", got, ok)
	}
}

func TestSchema_ObjectVariant(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"type":"string","minLength":3}`)
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	obj, ok := s.TypeObject()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("TypeObject ok=false, want true")
	}
	if obj.MinLength == nil {
		t.Errorf("MinLength = nil, want non-nil")
	}
}
